final: WITH units AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) AS ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), baselines AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(ownership) AS mix_baseline FROM units GROUP BY ordertypedist), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ownership) AS overall_ownership FROM units) SELECT AVG(u.ownership) AS average_ownership, AVG(u.ownership / b.mix_baseline) AS average_relative_to_mix, AVG(u.ownership - o.overall_ownership) AS average_excess FROM units AS u JOIN baselines AS b ON u.ordertypedist = b.ordertypedist CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE u.ownership > o.overall_ownership
